_comment: The people and institutions worth following, and the lists that gather them. Everything in this file is typed in by the owner: nothing is scraped, and nothing is filled in for a field nobody has checked.

THE THREE ENTRIES MARKED "placeholder": true BELOW ARE NOT REAL PEOPLE. They show the layout while this is built, appear only on a computer that sets SHOW_PLACEHOLDERS=1, and are served to nobody on the live site. Delete them when the first real entry is added.

A person: { id (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens), name, type: "person", roleType: "founder" | "operator" | "investor", title, orgName, orgType: "company" | "firm" | null, city, whyFollow (140 characters at most), links: { website, linkedin, x } (http(s) addresses or null), sources: [{ label, url }], verifiedAt (a date, and then at least one source: a check no page backs is not shown), vouches: [{ name, role, note, consented }] }. A vouch is shown only where consented is true.

An institution: { id, name, type: "institution", city, stageFocus, sectors: [], website, sources: [{ label, url }], verifiedAt }. The investors already published in the Command Center appear under Institutions without being listed here; list one here only to add a firm that is not among them.

A list: { id, title, description, curator, type: "people" | "institutions" | "companies", itemIds: [] }. itemIds name entries of that kind (a company by its slug; a published investor as "investor-<slug>"). A list with no one on it is not shown.
Only public professional information, with the page that says it. Do not copy from LinkedIn or any site by machine. See docs/people.md.
